Form navigation between steps (forward and backward)
Plan selection and comparison table functionality
Admin dashboard stats page with all stat cards
Admin navigation (Dashboard, Orders, Edit Requests, Support)
All admin dashboard APIs (stats, orders, edit-requests, support-tickets)
